```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

#CT_stops <- read.csv("C:/Users/Blake/Desktop/Stat 443/Midterm/Contraband-Traffic-Stops/data/CT_stops.csv")



CT_clean <- CT_stops %>%
  select(
    -driver_age_raw,
    -driver_race_raw,
    -violation_raw,
    -search_type_raw,
    -state,
    -stop_date,
    -fine_grained_location,
    -police_department,
    -location_raw,
    -stop_outcome,
    -is_arrested,
  )
names(CT_clean)
View(CT_clean)

```

```{r}
#Changing age into baskets
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
CT_clean <- CT_clean %>%
  mutate(
    driver_age_group = cut(
      driver_age,
      breaks = c(14, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 150),
      labels = c(
        "15-20", "21-25", "26-30", "31-35", "36-40",
        "41-45", "46-50", "51-55", "56-60", "61-65", "66+"
      ),
      right = TRUE
    )
  )

ggplot(
  CT_clean,
  aes(x = factor(
    driver_age_group,
    levels = c(
      "15-20", "21-25", "26-30", "31-35", "36-40",
      "41-45", "46-50", "51-55", "56-60", "61-65", "66+"
    )
  ))
) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Driver Age Groups",
    x = "Driver Age Group",
    y = "Number of Stops"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()





```
```{r}






CT_clean <- CT_clean %>%
  mutate(
    violation_group = case_when(
      is.na(violation) ~ NA_character_,

      # Keep combinations separate
      grepl(",", violation) ~ "Multiple violations",

      violation == "Speeding" ~ "Speeding",

      violation %in% c(
        "Moving violation", "Stop sign/light", "Safe movement"
      ) ~ "Other moving violations",

      violation %in% c(
        "Registration/plates", "License"
      ) ~ "Registration/license",

      violation %in% c(
        "Equipment", "Lights"
      ) ~ "Equipment/lights",

      violation %in% c(
        "Cell phone", "Seat belt"
      ) ~ "Cell phone/seat belt",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    violation_group = factor(violation_group)
  )

# Check the groups and their counts
CT_clean %>%
  count(violation_group, sort = TRUE)





CT_clean <- CT_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        driver_race,
        violation,
        search_conducted,
        search_type,
        contraband_found,
        driver_gender,
        county_name,
        stop_duration,
        violation_group
      ),
      as.factor
    )
  )

# Check the updated column types
str(CT_clean)


write.csv(CT_clean, "CT_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
For cleaning the data we:
Got rid of the raw data
Factor the different components that needed to be factored quantitative predictors
reduced the 118 violation levels to seven broader categories. Similar single violations were grouped together while stops listing multiple violations were assigned to a separate category to avoid arbitrarily selecting one violation 

```{r}
# Keep only stops where a search was conducted
CT_searches <- CT_clean %>%
  filter(search_conducted == "TRUE")


CT_searches %>%
  summarise(
    rows_remaining = n(),
    contraband_count = sum(contraband_found == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_contraband = mean(contraband_found == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Count and calculate the percentage missing for every variable
missing_summary_searches <- data.frame(
  variable = names(CT_searches),
  missing_count = colSums(is.na(CT_searches)),
  percent_missing = round(
    colMeans(is.na(CT_searches)) * 100, 2
  )
) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_missing))

missing_summary_searches
view(CT_searches)

write.csv(CT_searches, "CT_searches.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
